Rustify signs in with your browser session, as on the phone: open open.spotify.com signed in, copy the value of the sp_dc cookie and paste it here. It stays on this computer.

What Rustify has written since it started, kept in memory until it closes.
No speech engine was found on this computer, so the DJ stays silent. On Linux, install speech-dispatcher (spd-say) or espeak-ng.

Heuristic works offline. External AI sends your listening context to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (opt-in). Local model asks a language model running on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp), on its graphics card where it has one: nothing leaves the computer.
Looking for a model server on this computer…
No model server is running on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio or llama.cpp's llama-server). Until one is, the DJ uses the heuristic.
This server has no model yet: pull or load one in it first.
Rustify's own: llama.cpp with a model downloaded here

Without Ollama or LM Studio, Rustify can download llama.cpp's server for this computer (with CUDA, Vulkan or Metal where it can, else for the CPU) and one small model, and run it only on 127.0.0.1 while the app is open.

Ask anything, or ask it to play, queue or find music, start a mix, pause or skip. It is the model the DJ asks: a model server on this computer (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp or Rustify's own), or the external AI chosen for the DJ in Settings when it uses one. With a local model the conversation stays on this computer; when it plays or finds something, only that search goes out, like any search in the app.
No model to chat with: none is running on this computer. Start Ollama, LM Studio or llama-server, or get Rustify's own below; or choose External AI for the DJ in Settings.
Asks the service set for the DJ. Choose “External AI (API)” in the DJ’s settings.
No photos here: the model is asked in text only, since a model server reads images only with a vision model, and the one running may not be.
Each answer shows its times but not its speed in tokens per second: not every model server says how many tokens it wrote.
no language model is running on this computer, and the DJ uses no external AI

This device has no location: pick Origin first, then search a place or long-press the map.
Downloads are saved on the server, in its downloads folder, and join its music for every browser that opens it.
The server has no folder for downloads. Start it with --download-dir to download from the browser.
